Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:10:1.english: It has no fruit - Retribution is not exacted from him more than the measure of his wickedness.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:11:1.hebrew: עבירה שעושה פירות - כגון חילול השם, שאדם חשוב עובר עבירה, ואחרים למדין ממנו לעשות כן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:11:1.english: A transgression that produces fruit - Such as desecration of the Name, where a prominent person commits a transgression and others learn from him to do so.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:11:2.english: A thought that produces fruit - That he fulfilled his thought and acted.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:12:1.english: A thought that produces fruit - That he fulfilled his intention and acted.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:12:2.english: Links it to the action - And retribution is exacted from him even for the thought.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:15:1.hebrew: עולא אמר - הא דכתיב פרי מחשבותם — בעובר ושונה כתיב. כי הדר מהרהר לעשות, מצטרפת למעשה; ואפי' לא עביד לה — אין חזרתו לשם שמים, אלא שלא הוצרך לה, כדרב הונא, דאמר: נעשית לו כהיתר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:15:1.english: Ulla said - That which is written: “The fruit of their thoughts” — it is written regarding [one who] transgresses and repeats [his transgression]. When he contemplates doing [it] again, [the thought] is linked to action; and even if he does not [actually] perform it, his refraining is not for the sake of Heaven, but rather because he had no need for it, in accordance with [the statement of] Rav Huna, who said: It becomes to him like [something] permitted.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:16:1.hebrew: ואת שם קדשי לא תחללו - היינו פרהסיא, שהרואה מזלזל בכבוד המקום:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:16:1.english: And My sacred name you shall not profane - This refers to [sinning in] public, for one who sees [it] treats the honor of the Omnipresent with disrespect.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:17:1.hebrew: ילבש שחורים - שלא יראה עצמו בכבודו, אולי ירך לבבו בכך. וגם אם יחטא, אין אדם נותן לב, לפי שאינו חשוב בעיניהם — לכן ילבש שחורים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:17:1.english: He should wear black - So that he does not see himself in his dignity; perhaps his heart will soften through this. And even if he does sin, no one pays attention [to him], because he is not important in their eyes; therefore, he should wear black.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:1:1.english: Such as Rabbi Tzadok - Who clothed himself with strength to subdue his [evil] inclination [and] to prevail in the desires of his Maker.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:20:1.hebrew: אין עושין לו כחנווני - המקיף לאדם פעמים רבות וגובה כל הקפותיו יחד — אין עושין כך מלמעלה למחללי השם, אלא נפרעין מיד:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:20:1.english: They do not act toward him like a storekeeper - [Who] extends credit to a person many times and collects all his extensions of credit together — they do not act this way from Above toward those who desecrate the Name, but rather they exact retribution immediately.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:20:2.hebrew: שאם היתה - כף המאזנים שקולה, ויש באחד העונות חילול השם — מכריע את הכף לחובה. והאי מקיפין לשון עיוני, כמו: אין מקיפין בבועי (חולין דף מו:), אקפינהו ואידמו (שם דף נ.) — שמקריב זו אצל זו ומעיין אם דומות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:20:2.english: That if it was - [Meaning, that if] the scale pan was balanced, and one of the sins is a desecration of the Name — it tilts the scale toward liability. And this [word] makkifin is an expression of examination, as in: “One does not compare blisters” (Chullin 46b), [and:] “He brought them together and they resembled [each other]” (ibid. 50a) — in that one brings this [one] near to that [one] and examines whether they are similar.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:1.hebrew: אמר מאי נפקא מינה - דהא מילתא דלא נזדמן לי אלא מאכל טמא, יש לי ללמוד מכאן: דעביד האי — הבועל ארמית — ראוי למאכל טמא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:1.english: He said: What difference is there? - For from this matter, that nothing presented itself to me except non-kosher food, I must learn from here: One who does this — one who cohabits with an Aramean woman — is fit for non-kosher food.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:2.hebrew: שגרת תנורא - אותה ארמית הסיקה את התנור לצלות דבר הטמא שם. ואשה גדולה היתה, שאין יכול ליפטר ממנה, ומסור בידה להורגו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:2.english: She lit the oven - That gentile woman heated the oven to roast the non-kosher food there. And she was a prominent woman, such that he was unable to get away from her, and [he was] in her power to kill him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:3.english: She was placing it - [She was placing] that roast inside it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:4.english: Falls into this - Into the fire of Gehenna.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:2:5.english: If I had known - Had I known that the matter was so grave for you.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:3:1.english: Baskets woven from palm leaves - Baskets in which women place their spindles.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:3:2.hebrew: אטרחתן - שהייתי במקום אחר, רחוק ד' מאות פרסי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:3:2.english: You have troubled me - For I was in another place, four hundred parasangs away.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:3:3.hebrew: לאו עניותא - בתמיה: אם לא העניות, לא הוצרכתי להיות עסקי במלאכת נשים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:3:3.english: Was it not poverty - [Spoken] as a rhetorical question: If not for poverty, I would not have needed my occupation to be in women's crafts.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:5:1.english: [That] your days may be long - [This refers to] the World-to-Come.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:5:2.english: That it may go well with you - In your lifetime.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:5:3.hebrew: ימצא חיים - לעולם הבא; צדקה וכבוד — בעולם הזה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:5:3.english: Shall find life - In the World to Come; [while] “prosperity and honor” [are] in this world.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:6:1.hebrew: חייך - בעולם הזה, ואורך ימים — לעולם הבא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:6:1.english: Your life - In this world; and “the length of days” [is] for the World to Come.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:7:1.english: With regard to the dispatch of the nest as well, etc. - And let [the Tanna] teach it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:8:1.hebrew: רבי אידי אסברא לי - אינו דומה לאלו, דהנך כולהו הבריות נהנין ממנו, ונמצא טוב לשמים וטוב לבריות. ובההוא כתיב: ״כי פרי מעלליהם יאכלו״ — דבהאי קרא כתיב ״כי טוב״, כי פרי מעלליו יאכל בחייו. אבל בשילוח הקן — טוב לשמים הוא, ואין כאן טוב לבריות, ולא כתיב ביה ״כי פרי מעלליו יאכל״; והלכך, לא תנייה גבי ״אוכל פירותיהן בעולם הזה״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:8:1.english: Rabbi Idi explained [it] to me - [Dispatching the nest] is not similar to these [mitzvot], for in all of those, people benefit from him, and he is thus good toward Heaven and good toward people. And regarding that [person], it is written: “For they shall eat the fruit of their actions,” as in this verse it is written “that [he is] good,” [meaning] that he shall eat the fruit of his actions in his lifetime. But regarding dispatching the nest, it is good toward Heaven, but there is no goodness toward people here, and it is not written regarding it that he shall eat the fruit of his actions. And therefore, [the Mishnah] did not teach it among [those regarding which one] “eats their fruits in this world.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:9:1.english: Evil toward Heaven and evil toward people - Such as a murderer, a robber, and a thief.

Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:9:2.hebrew: רע לשמים ואינו רע לבריות - מגלה עריות, מבזה מועדים, אוכל חלב:
Rashi on Kiddushin 40a:9:2.english: Evil toward Heaven and not evil toward people - [Such as] one who engages in forbidden sexual relations, treats the Festivals with contempt, [or] eats forbidden fat.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 40a:17:1.hebrew: ויעשה מה שלבו חפץ - פי' ר"ח: ח"ו שהותר לו לעבור עבירה, אלא כך אמר ר' אלעאי: יגיעת דרכים, והאכסנאות, ולבישת שחורים משברים יצר הרע, ומונעים אדם מן העבירה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 40a:17:1.english: "And he should do what his heart desires" - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: God forbid that it was permitted for him to commit a sin! Rather, this is what Rabbi Ilai said: The weariness of travel, lodging [as a stranger], and wearing black clothes break the evil inclination and prevent a person from sinning.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 40a:20:1.hebrew: אין מקיפין בחילול השם - פר"ח: משנה במסכת אבות. ושמא היינו הא דתנן (פ"ד מ"ד): "כל המחלל שם שמים בסתר, נפרעין ממנו בגלוי". אבל לשון מקיפין קשה; ושמא ברייתא היא, אף על גב דאומר תנן:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 40a:20:1.english: "Credit is not given with regard to the desecration of the Name" - Rabbeinu Chananel explained: [It is] a mishna in tractate Avot. And perhaps this is that which we learned (chapter 4, mishna 4): "Whoever desecrates the Name of Heaven in secret, they exact payment from him in public." However, the phrasing "makkifin" is difficult; and perhaps it is a baraita, even though [the Gemara] says "we learned" [tenan].
